tests.name: bot-flows.json has welcome_message and after_hours_message
tests.detail: bot-flows.json is a bare array of flows with no wrapper object. No top-level 'welcome_message' or 'after_hours_message' keys exist. The 'hours' flow covers business hours info in its message text, but dedicated welcome_message and after_hours_message fields are absent. Fix: wrap the array in an object with these keys, or configure welcome/after-hours messages directly in Freshchat Admin > Bot Settings.

next_steps: 1. Fix bot-flows.json: wrap the flows array in an object with 'welcome_message', 'after_hours_message', and 'flows' keys (or set these in Freshchat Admin > Bot Settings directly)
2. Copy .env.template to .env and fill in all real API keys: OpenRouter, Freshchat, Google OAuth (Client ID + Secret), Apollo, HubSpot, Stripe (live key + webhook secret), SMTP password, Calendly
3. Run scripts/setup-env.ps1 to verify all 8 core environment variables load correctly with no placeholders
4. Create Make.com account and import each scenario JSON via Make > Scenarios > Import Blueprint (upload the JSON files)
5. Create Make.com connections: Freshchat (HTTP + API key), Google Calendar (OAuth2), Gmail (OAuth2), HubSpot (Private App token), Stripe (API key + webhook signing secret)
6. Register Scenario A webhook URL in Freshchat Admin > Settings > Webhooks > New Message
7. Register Scenario D webhook URL in Apollo > Settings > Integrations > Webhooks > contact.enrolled_in_sequence
8. Register Scenario E webhook URL in Apollo > Settings > Integrations > Webhooks > email.reply_received
9. Register Scenario F webhook URL in Stripe Dashboard > Developers > Webhooks > payment_intent.succeeded

10. Create required HubSpot custom company properties for Scenario C KPIs (cwi_last_report_month, cwi_total_conversations, cwi_bot_resolved, cwi_containment_rate, cwi_escalation_rate, cwi_appointments_booked, cwi_avg_response_time, cwi_report_sent_date)
11. Create Google Sheets spreadsheet with 'ActiveClients' tab containing columns: client_name, client_email, freshchat_account_id, google_calendar_id, hubspot_company_id, industry, calendly_link
12. Configure Freshchat bot flows using freshchat/bot-flows.json in Freshchat Admin > Bots > Create Bot
13. Test Scenario A end-to-end: send a chat with keyword 'book an appointment' to the Freshchat widget, verify Google Calendar event is created and confirmation email is sent
14. Test Scenario F with Stripe CLI: stripe trigger payment_intent.succeeded, verify HubSpot note is created
